outcome: Prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding under six months
finding: The prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding was low in Addis Ababa, and factors such as mothers' income, antenatal and postnatal counseling, and mode of delivery were associated with EBF practices.
mod_finding: Mothers who gave birth vaginally were more likely to exclusively breastfeed than those who had a Caesarean section.
